notes: In the Elqui Valley, Syrah and Sauvignon Blanc lead, and the cool climate makes Syrah spicy and complex.
The Limarí Valley's limestone soils and sea breezes give Chardonnay an attractive minerality.

blurb.text: A Chilean region that includes the Elqui, Limarí and Choapa Valleys. Chardonnay is the most planted grape at 26 percent of vines, followed by Syrah at 15 percent, Pedro Giménez and Sauvignon Blanc.
